\textbf{Part A --- Lessons}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, label=\textbf{A\arabic*.}, itemsep=1pt]
    \item Super sources and virtual vertices
    \item Layered (product) graphs: vertex = (state, layer)
    \item Segment-tree-optimised edges: ranges of edges in $\bigO{\log n}$
    \item Complement graphs (traversal with a set of unvisited vertices) and vertices for values (bucket and divisor graphs)
    \item Game graphs with cycles: win / lose / draw by retrograde BFS from the terminal states
\end{enumerate}
